Description - ExternalJob Description: Senior Full Stack Developer (6–9 Years Experience)

 

Location: Bengaluru

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Full Stack Developer with 6–9 years of industry experience to lead the design, development, and deployment of scalable enterprise-grade applications. The candidate will play a critical role in architectural decision-making, system optimization, and mentoring junior developers while ensuring high-quality delivery across the technology stack.

 

This role requires strong technical depth across frontend, backend, databases, and DevOps ecosystems, along with the ability to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

Architecture & System Design

- Design scalable, secure, and high-performance system architectures across frontend and backend layers.

- Drive technical design discussions and define best practices, coding standards, and development guidelines.

- Evaluate and recommend appropriate technology stacks, frameworks, and tools based on project requirements.

- Contribute to microservices architecture, distributed systems, and event-driven design patterns.

- Ensure system reliability, fault tolerance, and scalability through proper architectural decisions.

 

Full Stack Development

- Lead the development of complex web applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern frameworks such as React.

- Design and develop backend services and APIs using technologies such as .NET, Java, Python, or Node.js.

- Build reusable, modular, and maintainable code libraries and frameworks.

- Handle complex integrations with third-party systems, enterprise platforms, and APIs.

 

Database & Data Engineering

- Architect and optimize relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB).

- Design efficient data models, indexing strategies, and query optimization techniques.

- Implement data migration strategies and ensure data security and compliance.

- Handle large-scale data processing and performance tuning.

 

DevOps & Cloud Engineering

- Lead containerization strategies using Docker and orchestration with Kubernetes.

- Design and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment.

- Work with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP for infrastructure provisioning and scaling.

- Implement monitoring, logging, and observability solutions.

- Drive infrastructure automation using Infrastructure-as-Code principles where applicable.

 

Performance Optimization & Reliability

- Identify bottlenecks across application layers and implement performance improvements.

- Conduct root cause analysis for production incidents and implement preventive measures.

- Ensure high availability, scalability, and system resilience.

- Implement caching strategies, load balancing, and performance monitoring tools.

 

Technical Leadership & Mentorship

- Mentor junior and mid-level developers through code reviews and technical guidance.

- Provide technical leadership across multiple projects or modules.

- Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders including product managers, architects, and DevOps teams.

- Participate in sprint planning, estimations, and technical risk assessments.

 

Quality & Governance

- Establish and enforce coding standards, testing strategies, and security best practices.

- Implement automated testing strategies including unit, integration, and end-to-end testing.

- Ensure compliance with security standards and data protection practices.

- Maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and knowledge repositories.

 

Required Skills

- Strong expertise in HTML, CSS, JavaScript.

- Experience with React or similar frontend frameworks.

- Backend technologies such as .NET, Java, Python, or Node.js.

- Deep understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices, and distributed system design.

- Experience with relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB).

- Hands-on experience with Git, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.

- Strong knowledge of system design principles, scalability, and performance optimization.

- Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

- Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.

 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with event-driven architectures and message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.).

- Knowledge of security frameworks and authentication mechanisms (OAuth, JWT, SSO).

- Exposure to domain-driven design (DDD) principles.

- Experience leading technical teams or modules.

- Familiarity with AI/ML integration or modern data platforms is a plus.

 

Education Requirements

- Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (Computer Science or Information Technology) is required.

- Candidates from other educational backgrounds may be considered if they have 100% relevant professional experience in full stack development.

 

Experience

- 6 to 9 years of relevant experience in full stack software development with demonstrated experience in handling complex enterprise systems.

 

Key Competencies

- Technical leadership and ownership mindset.

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Strategic thinking and architectural problem-solving.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects.

- Continuous learning and innovation mindset.

Description - ExternalJob Description: Solution Architect / Lead Full Stack Architect (10+ Years Experience)

 

Location: Bengaluru

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect with 10+ years of experience in designing and delivering enterprise-scale technology solutions across full stack ecosystems. This role requires deep expertise in application architecture, cloud platforms, distributed systems, enterprise security, and integration patterns.

 

The candidate will be responsible for translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions, driving architecture strategy, and leading engineering teams to deliver secure, high-performance, and maintainable systems.

 

This role combines hands-on technical depth with architectural leadership, stakeholder engagement, and delivery accountability.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

Solution Architecture & Technical Strategy

- Define end-to-end solution architecture across frontend, backend, data, security, and infrastructure layers.

- Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and high-performance system designs.

- Drive technology selection, architecture standards, and engineering best practices.

- Lead architectural governance, design reviews, and technical decision-making processes.

- Develop reference architectures, reusable frameworks, and platform strategies.

- Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture principles and organizational technology roadmap.

 

Enterprise Application Architecture

- Design complex applications using modern frontend frameworks (React or similar) and backend technologies (.NET, Java, Python, Node.js).

- Architect microservices, distributed systems, and event-driven architectures.

- Define API strategy including REST, GraphQL, and integration standards.

- Lead modernization initiatives such as monolith-to-microservices transformation.

- Ensure scalability, resiliency, fault tolerance, and performance optimization.

 

Cloud & DevOps Architecture

- Architect cloud-native solutions using AWS, Azure, or GCP.

- Define containerization and orchestration strategies using Docker and Kubernetes.

- Design CI/CD architecture, automation pipelines, and release strategies.

- Implement Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and environment automation.

- Establish monitoring, logging, observability, and reliability engineering practices.

- Define deployment strategies including blue-green, canary, and rolling deployments.

 

Data & Integration Architecture

- Design enterprise data architectures across relational (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB) systems.

- Define data governance, security, and compliance strategies.

- Architect integrations with third-party platforms, enterprise systems, and APIs.

- Implement messaging systems, event streaming, and asynchronous communication patterns (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.).

- Handle large-scale data processing, caching strategies, and performance optimization.

 

Security Architecture & Identity Management

- Define end-to-end application security architecture across systems and services.

- Design and implement Identity and Access Management (IAM) strategies including authentication and authorization models.

- Implement Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC).

- Design Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and federated identity (SAML, OAuth2, OpenID Connect).

- Integrate with enterprise identity providers such as Azure AD, Okta, Auth0, or similar platforms.

- Define secure API access mechanisms including token-based authentication (JWT).

- Implement secrets management and secure credential storage.

- Ensure compliance with enterprise security standards and regulatory requirements.

- Conduct architecture risk assessments, threat modeling, and mitigation planning.

- Establish DevSecOps practices including automated security scanning and vulnerability management.

 

Performance, Reliability & Scalability

- Ensure high availability, scalability, and system resilience.

- Implement caching strategies, load balancing, and distributed system optimization.

- Conduct root cause analysis for production incidents and implement preventive solutions.

- Define SLAs, SLOs, and reliability engineering practices.

 

Technical Leadership & Delivery Ownership

- Lead engineering teams across multiple projects or programs.

- Provide technical direction, mentoring, and coaching to developers and technical leads.

- Participate in sprint planning, estimations, and delivery governance.

- Resolve complex technical challenges and production issues.

- Ensure quality, maintainability, and long-term sustainability of solutions.

 

Stakeholder & Business Collaboration

- Collaborate with business stakeholders, product managers, and leadership to define technology solutions.

- Communicate architectural decisions, trade-offs, and risks clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

- Support presales activities, solution proposals, and technical estimations where required.

- Drive innovation initiatives and continuous improvement strategies.

 

Required Skills & Expertise

- Strong expertise in HTML, CSS, JavaScript.

- Modern frontend frameworks (React or similar).

- Backend technologies (.NET, Java, Python, Node.js).

- Deep knowledge of microservices architecture, distributed systems, API design, and cloud-native principles.

- Strong experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM) and enterprise security architecture.

- Experience with relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB).

- Expertise with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices.

- Strong cloud architecture experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

- Proven experience leading large-scale or complex technology implementations.

 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with domain-driven design (DDD) and event-driven architecture.

- Knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF or similar).

- Experience with solution estimation, budgeting, and resource planning.

- Architecture certifications (AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Architect, etc.) are a plus.

- Exposure to AI/ML platforms, modern analytics ecosystems, or data engineering is a plus.

 

Education Requirements

- Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (Computer Science or Information Technology) is required.

- Candidates from other educational backgrounds may be considered if they have 100% relevant professional experience in software engineering and architecture.

 

Experience

- 10+ years of experience in software development with significant experience in solution architecture and technical leadership roles.

- Proven track record of delivering complex enterprise-scale systems.

 

Key Competencies

- Strategic thinking and architecture vision.

- Strong leadership and decision-making ability.

- Stakeholder management and communication skills.

- Risk assessment and problem-solving capability.

- Ownership and accountability mindset.

- Continuous learning and innovation orientation.

Location: Bengaluru

Role Overview

We are seeking an AI Architect with 6–9 years of overall IT experience, including 3–4 years of hands-on experience in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or Generative AI solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong full stack engineering background combined with expertise in designing, developing, and deploying AI-powered systems at scale.

 

This role involves defining AI architecture strategies, integrating AI capabilities into enterprise applications, enabling intelligent automation, and guiding engineering teams through the AI adoption journey.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

1. AI Solution Architecture & Strategy

- Design end-to-end AI solutions across data, model, application, and infrastructure layers.

- Translate business problems into AI-driven technical architectures.

- Define AI platform architecture, model deployment strategies, and integration patterns.

- Evaluate and select appropriate AI/ML frameworks, tools, and technologies.

- Provide architecture guidance for AI initiatives across the organization.

- Architect and develop Generative AI applications including LLM integrations, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering frameworks, and AI agents.

- Develop intelligent features within enterprise applications.

 

3. AI Integration with Enterprise Systems

- Integrate AI solutions with web applications, APIs, databases, and enterprise platforms.

- Design microservices and API-based architectures for AI services.

- Enable AI-powered automation across business workflows.

- Ensure seamless interaction between AI models and production systems.

 

4. MLOps & Deployment

- Define model deployment strategies including real-time inference and batch processing.

- Implement MLOps pipelines for model training, versioning, monitoring, and retraining.

- Work with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.

- Implement CI/CD pipelines for AI/ML systems.

- Monitor model performance, drift, and reliability in production environments.

 

5. Data Engineering & Infrastructure Collaboration

- Collaborate with data engineers to design data pipelines and feature engineering workflows.

- Define data requirements, storage strategies, and data governance considerations.

- Work with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP for AI infrastructure deployment.

- Optimize infrastructure for performance and cost efficiency.

 

6. Performance, Security & Governance

- Ensure scalability, reliability, and performance of AI solutions.

- Implement responsible AI practices including fairness, explainability, and bias mitigation.

- Define security and privacy controls for AI systems.

- Ensure compliance with data protection and regulatory standards.

 

7. Technical Leadership & Collaboration

- Provide technical leadership to engineering and AI teams.

- Mentor developers and data scientists on AI best practices.

- Participate in architecture reviews and technology decisions.

- Collaborate with product managers, business stakeholders, and leadership teams.

- Support AI adoption strategy and innovation initiatives.

 

Required Skills

- Strong full stack engineering background with experience in backend development (Python, Java, .NET, or Node.js), APIs, and microservices.

- Hands-on experience with AI/ML technologies including machine learning frameworks and Generative AI/LLM integrations.

- Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).

- Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.

- Strong understanding of AI system architecture and deployment patterns.

- Knowledge of data engineering and MLOps practices.

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with enterprise AI platform implementation.

- Exposure to vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Weaviate, etc.).

- Experience with AI observability and monitoring tools.

- Knowledge of NLP, computer vision, or recommendation systems.

- Experience with AI agents or automation frameworks.

- AI or cloud certifications are a plus.

 

Education Requirements

- Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (Computer Science or Information Technology) is required.

- Candidates from other educational backgrounds may be considered if they have 100% relevant professional experience.

 

Experience

- 6 to 9 years of overall IT experience.

- Minimum 3 to 4 years of hands-on experience in AI, Machine Learning, or Generative AI solutions.

 

Key Competencies

- Architectural thinking and system design capability.

- Innovation and problem-solving mindset.

- Strong technical leadership and mentoring ability.

- Communication and stakeholder collaboration skills.

- Continuous learning orientation.

Job Overview 

The People Consultant (formerly HR Business Partner) serves as a strategic and operational partner to designated business areas. This role provides expert consultation on People policies, organizational design, talent development, and associate relations. The People Consultant will coach leaders, mitigate risk, ensure compliance, and drive initiatives that support the Company’s position as an employer of choice.

Key Responsibilities:

  •       Advise leaders on employee relations issues, including conflict resolution, performance management, coaching, policy interpretation, and disciplinary       actions.

     

     

  •       Assess workforce, business, and organizational trends and translate insights into workforce strategies, organizational plans, and leadership actions to      support current and future business needs. Partner with business leaders to support workforce planning strategy, including headcount forecasting,            staffing plans, succession considerations, and workforce capability assessments.

     

     

  •      Conduct investigations into sexual harassment, discrimination, hostile work environment, and workplace violence claims.

     

     

  •      Coordinate employment-related legal actions and partner with Corporate Security, Business Practies Office, and Legal as needed.

     

     

  •      Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local employment laws, ISO standards, corporate audits, and internal People policies.

     

     

  •      Provide guidance to leaders on organizational structure, job banding, headcount planning, and job description development.

     

     

  •      Lead PT consultation activities associated with organizational change management initiatives, including communications and transition planning.

     

     

  •      Prepare reports, maintain documentation, and support audits and compliance reviews related to People programs and processes.

     

     

  •     Coordinate and facilitate training sessions related to People policies, programs, and processes.

     

     

  •      Advise leaders on talent strategy, including succession planning, leadership pipeline development, talent assessment, retention planning, and                    organizational capability building to support future business growth.

     

     

  •      Act as trusted advisor to managers and employees and partner with People colleagues to align and execute on People and corporate initiatives.

     

     

  •      Partner with the business, People Solutions Center (PSC), and Global Functional Teams (GFT) to align people strategies, advocate for business              needs, and support effective implementation of standardized People processes and services.

     

     

  •      Serve as a strategic organizational consultant along with talent advisor to business leaders by translating workforce, business, and organizational              trends  into actionable strategies.

     

     

  •      Provide guidance on employee relations, organizational design, workforce planning, change management, and talent development, and consulting on      the effective use of People policies, programs, processes, and solutions to support business objectives and organizational effectiveness.

Connected Cars Platform Developer

Experience: 3-6 years

This is a unique opportunity to be part of the team, which builds world’s best Connected Car Platform Functions

What we do?

·       We build solutions, which touches and defines the experience of more than 14 million Mercedes-Benz customers who use our connected car functions.

·       We invest in building resilient and scalable solutions in the cloud using best development practices and state of the art cloud platforms.

·       We believe if you build the best product then you don't have to worry about waking up in the middle of the night to address an incident!

·       We collaborate with colleagues from various delivery hubs of Mercedes Benz to deliver cutting edge in car experience for our customers.

·       We own end-to-end delivery responsibilities and promote/adopt "You build it you run it" culture.

·       We love polyglot programming and always choose the right technology and language to fit the need.

Ideal Candidate?

We are looking for talented technical professionals with proven experience in developing cloud-native microservices on Azure or AWS, using Java (Spring Boot framework), Kotlin or GoLang.

·       You can skillfully write high-quality, well-tested code by following clean code principles

·       You follow DevSecOps culture & practices

·       You have experience influencing others and always advocate for technical excellence while being open to change when needed

·       You are resilient in ambiguous situations and can approach challenges from multiple perspectives

·       You have rich experience in Cloud PaaS offerings as well as data management solutions like Postgres, Redis, Event Hub, Kafka etc.

·       Proficiency in working on Kubernetes and Containerized environments

Skillset

Spring Framework

  • Proficiency in Java and Spring Boot

Microservices Architecture

  • Designing and implementing microservices
  • Experience with RESTful APIs and inter-service communication

Kubernetes

  • Familiarity with Kubernetes concepts (pods, services, deployments, namespaces)
  • Experience with Helm charts
  • Understanding of AKS

Azure DevOps

  • Proficiency in Azure DevOps for CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience with YAML pipelines, build and release pipelines

Containerization

  • Experience with Docker
  • Understanding of container orchestration and management with Kubernetes

Monitoring and Logging

  • Proficiency in Datadog for monitoring, logging, and alerting
  • Experience with setting up dashboards, metrics, and log management
  • Azure Log Analytics

Cloud Infrastructure

  • Knowledge of Azure services and infrastructure management
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform is a plus

Security

  • Understanding of security best practices for microservices and Kubernetes
  • Experience with securing APIs, managing secrets, and implementing network policies

SDLC Understanding

  • Agile, Scrum, DevOps methodologies, SDLC stages

Test frameworks

·       TestNG, JUnit, NUnit, Custom test framework design and implementation

·       Cucumber and JUnit

Analytical Skill

  • Identifying test scenarios, Edge cases, Debugging, Issue resolution, defect description

Version Control Systems

  • Git/GitHub/GitLab

Database 

  •  PostgreSql

Roles & Responsibilities:

·       You will be responsible for entire software lifecycle from ideation to development, deployment & operations

·       You will design & build world class solutions to solve real world problems effectively

·       You will use continuous delivery practices to deliver high-quality software & provide incremental value to end customers

·       You will work in collaborative, cross-cultural, value driven teams to deliver innovative customer experiences

·       You will explore, adopt & champion the best technologies & practices

·       You will develop with scale and speed amidst flux & dynamic environment

PositionFormattedDescription.Tasks: Position Title: Cloud Data Engineer – Connected Cars & Vehicle Data Platforms Function / Department: Connected Cars | Vehicle Data Platforms & Cloud Engineering Location: Bengaluru Employment Type: Full-time Experience: 4+ Years Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or related technical discipline About MBRDI Mercedes-Benz Research and Development India (MBRDI), headquartered in Bengaluru with a satellite office in Pune, is the largest R&D center of Mercedes-Benz Group AG outside Germany. Within MBRDI, the Connected Cars and Vehicle Data Platforms organization builds large-scale, cloud-native data ecosystems that power vehicle connectivity, telemetry processing, digital services, analytics, and data-driven decision making across the Mercedes-Benz global landscape. PositionFormattedDescription.Tasks:
SAP Focused Run (FRUN) Service Manager / Project Manager

Role Purpose

The SAP Focused Run (FRUN) Service Manager / Project Manager is responsible for the governance, delivery, and continuous improvement of FRUN services, with a primary focus on Compliance Monitoring across enterprise SAP landscapes. The role acts as the primary interface between Application Owners and the FRUN Operations and SME teams, ensuring effective service delivery, stakeholder engagement, audit readiness, and successful onboarding of SAP systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end onboarding of SAP systems into FRUN, including Compliance Monitoring, Data Suppliers, and Data Collectors.
  • Manage project plans, timelines, risks, dependencies, milestones, and stakeholder communications to ensure successful delivery.
  • Own service governance activities, ensuring compliance with established standards, processes, and service level agreements.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for Application Owners, driving collaboration, service adoption, and customer satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with SAP Basis, Security, Infrastructure, Operations, and SME teams to resolve issues and manage escalations effectively.
  • Prepare and present weekly operational reports, management dashboards, KPI reviews, and service performance updates.
  • Support internal and external audits by ensuring monitoring controls, compliance requirements, and audit evidence are maintained.
  • Identify and drive continuous service improvement opportunities through automation, process optimization, and enhanced monitoring capabilities.
  • Develop service improvement roadmaps and ensure delivery of measurable business and operational benefits.

Qualifications & Experience

Strong experience in SAP FRUN, Service Delivery, Project Management, Stakeholder Management, Governance, Compliance Monitoring, Reporting, Audit Management, and Continuous Service Improvement. ITIL and Project Management certifications are preferred.

SAP Data Archiving & Document Management Service Manager

Role Purpose

The SAP Data Archiving & Document Management Service Manager is responsible for leading the strategy, governance, delivery, standardization, and continuous improvement of SAP Data Archiving and Document Management services across the enterprise. Acting as the primary engagement lead for Application Owners, the role is accountable for understanding business requirements, defining archiving strategies, establishing implementation roadmaps, and ensuring successful execution of archiving initiatives while delivering high-quality, compliant, and scalable services.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with Application Owners to assess archiving requirements, define project scope, retention policies, compliance obligations, and expected business outcomes.
  • Develop application-specific archiving strategies, implementation roadmaps, and delivery plans aligned with business, legal, audit, and regulatory requirements.
  • Lead end-to-end delivery of SAP Data Archiving and Document Management projects, including planning, governance, risk management, stakeholder coordination, and operational transition.
  • Facilitate and drive discussions with Business, Legal, Audit, Compliance, SAP Product Teams, SAP CS Leads, and technical teams to ensure alignment and timely decision-making.
  • Establish and continuously enhance service standards, operating procedures, onboarding frameworks, accelerators, templates, reusable assets, and best practices.
  • Leverage industry best practices and lessons learned from ongoing and completed projects to improve delivery quality, consistency, scalability, and time-to-value.
  • Drive service excellence by ensuring delivery with the highest levels of quality, compliance, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency.
  • Foster strong collaboration across Application Owners, SAP teams, Operations, SMEs, and key stakeholders to drive successful outcomes and improve stakeholder engagement.
  • Lead service governance through KPI reporting, management reviews, audit readiness, issue resolution, risk management, and escalation management.
  • Identify opportunities for automation, process optimization, cost reduction, and continuous service improvement to enhance service maturity and business value realization.

Required Experience

Strong experience in SAP Data Archiving, SAP ILM, SAP Document Management/OpenText, Service Delivery, Program & Project Management, Governance, Compliance, Audit Management, and Stakeholder Engagement. Proven ability to define service standards, drive cross-functional collaboration, and deliver complex programs with measurable business outcomes. ITIL and Project Management certifications are preferred.

PositionFormattedDescription.Tasks:
WHAT WE DO

Picture the car of the future. Does it fly? Does it look like the one from that famous 80s movie? 

We believe the car of the future is already here—and it’s a connected vehicle that can be used as a payment device. Here at Mercedes pay, we enable seamless, secure, and trustworthy payments across the entire Mercedes-Benz ecosystem. We develop sleek new payment products & solutions to provide customers with an effortless, convenient user experience; not just via an app or web browser, but even in-car. The car as a payment device? We made it happen! 

Mercedes-Benz is known for its legacy, but innovation and legacy are not mutually exclusive—quite the contrary. Our mission is to empower innovation within one of the top luxury car brands worldwide, helping it continue to pioneer the automotive industry. To sum it up, we are the FinTech branch or knowledge hub for payments within Mercedes-Benz.

ABOUT MERCEDES PAY

Mercedes pay launched in its first market in 2018 and is now active in more than 40 countries on five continents, enabling transaction processing for Mercedes-Benz products and services. Depending on the market, Mercedes pay may act as the technical payment gateway for transaction processing from Mercedes me store, the Mercedes me app, in-car payments and may even support online vehicle sales. This is how Mercedes pay directly contributes to the mobility and digitalization strategy of Mercedes-Benz Group AG. Mercedes pay is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz AG with offices in Berlin, Stuttgart, and Farmington Hills (USA).

2023 has already been a big year—we launched full online vehicle payments in the UK and introduced native in-car payments in Germany, an industry-first feature by which users can pay directly by fingerprint inside their car. That’s the car of the future we’re talking about! 

OUR VALUES & HOW WE WORK

We are an inclusive, passionate, and diverse team of people. Being solution-oriented, agile, and dynamic is in our blood. We learn best by leaping into cold water from time to time, by doing rather than deliberating, and we trust in our teammates’ abilities & willingness to learn. We like to make things happen, and we’re more interested in finding solutions than sulking at inconveniences.

Since we are still building new processes alongside new products, new joiners have the opportunity to make as much impact as our most seasoned veterans. We really love a lively exchange of ideas, whether a teammate’s been with us for two days or ten years. And, frankly, fresh energy is always welcome.

YOUR DAY AT GLANCE

  • Collaborate in a dynamic, diverse, and innovation-driven environment, where your experience and leadership will be valued.

  • Design, set up, maintain, and continually enhance our AWS cloud resources using infrastructure-as-code and support the roll-out of new payment products and services from infrastructure perspective.

  • Take ownership of deployments during releases and ensuring the sound functioning of CI/CD pipelines.

  • Further develop our data pipeline with integrations to various systems.

  • Leverage your Datadog expertise to enhance and maintain platform reliability and monitoring.

  • Drive IT Operations during the roll-out of existing products to new markets and use-cases.

  • Collaborate with Mercedes-Benz Group IT specialists and external providers to co-create innovative solutions.

  • Play a key role in ensuring the operational excellence of our global payment platform.

  • Ensure compliance of all operational products with Mercedes policies and relevant external laws and regulations.
PositionFormattedDescription.Qualifications:
WHAT WE EXPECT

  • A burning passion for IT, along with an open-minded and highly motivated attitude.

  • Successful completion of relevant studies in Computer Science or equivalent work experience.

  • Strong solution-oriented, problem-solving and analytical skills.

  • Proficiency in cloud service architecture best practices and experience in writing infrastructure-as-code.

  • Skilled at Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm and experience with software programming (e.g. Java), Git SCM, and proficiency in the Atlassian Toolchain.

  • Datadog hands-on experience, and deep understanding of features and capabilities.

  • Experience with platform reliability best practices, set up of monitors, automated alerts and on-call service.

  • Knowledge of IT security best practice and common standards.

  • Fluent business English skills.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Modern and dynamic work environment
  • Flexible and mobile working
  • Attractive fitness offer
  • Numerous employee discounts
  • Excellent infrastructure

This is a full-time job (also suitable for part-time). We particularly welcome applications from disabled persons. Please apply online via www.group.mercedes-benz.com/careers (ID:MER0003ZHR). For questions, please don’t hesitate to contact the HR Team of Mercedes pay GmbH: career_mercedespay@mercedes-benz.com

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect – SAP MM to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of enterprise-wide Materials Management solutions on SAP S/4HANA. This pivotal role involves strategic planning, technical leadership, and cross-functional collaboration to deliver scalable, high-performance SAP MM architectures aligned with business objectives. The ideal candidate combines deep SAP MM expertise with strong analytical capabilities and proven project delivery experience.

Key Responsibilities

Solution Design and Architecture

·        Act as the lead solution architect for SAP S/4HANA MM, overseeing complete solution design, configuration, and delivery aligned with organizational business goals and IT strategy.

·        Design end-to-end SAP MM architecture encompassing procurement, inventory management, and supply chain optimization processes.

·        Define SAP MM architecture and integration strategy with other SAP modules (SD, PP, FI/CO, QM) and non-SAP enterprise systems (e.g., Ariba, SuccessFactors, Concur).

·        Ensure seamless system integration and adherence to industry best practices, scalability requirements, and security standards.

·        Translate complex business requirements into detailed technical specifications and scalable, high-performance SAP solutions.

Requirement Analysis and Fit-Gap Assessment

·        Collaborate with stakeholders, business process owners, and enterprise teams to gather, analyze, and document comprehensive business requirements.

·        Lead fit-gap analysis workshops and blueprinting sessions, identifying process optimization opportunities and recommended enhancements.

·        Convert business needs into clear technical specifications, functional design documents, and architectural frameworks.

·        Provide strategic recommendations for process standardization and alignment with SAP best practices.

Implementation and Deployment

·        Lead SAP MM implementation projects from initiation through cutover, including configuration management, testing strategy definition, and data migration planning.

·        Oversee system configuration, data mapping, and technical integration points between MM and related modules.

·        Collaborate with SAP consultants, ABAP developers, and QA teams to define enhancements, customizations, and extensions (e.g., user exits, BADIs, web services).

·        Support testing activities including unit testing, integration testing, UAT, and system validation to ensure robust performance.

·        Manage cutover activities, including parallel runs, data validation, and go-live coordination.

Technical Leadership and Risk Management

·        Provide technical guidance and mentorship to SAP MM implementation teams, junior consultants, and technical resources.

·        Identify, assess, and mitigate technical risks; propose mitigation strategies and contingency plans for complex implementation challenges.

·        Conduct design and implementation reviews to ensure quality, compliance, and adherence to organizational standards.

·        Document architectural decisions, design rationale, and configuration guidelines for knowledge transfer.

Change Management and User Adoption

·        Lead change management initiatives including impact assessments, stakeholder communication, and organizational readiness planning.

·        Develop and execute user training strategies, including workshops, documentation, and hands-on training sessions.

·        Support post-implementation optimization, including performance tuning, process refinement, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Documentation and Communication

·        Produce comprehensive technical documentation including solution architectures, process flows, configuration guides, data migration strategies, and runbooks.

·        Communicate complex technical concepts to business stakeholders in understandable terms; ensure alignment between technical design and business objectives.

·        Maintain up-to-date architectural documentation and configuration repositories for future support and enhancements.
PositionFormattedDescription.Qualifications:
Experience

·        Minimum 7–10 years of professional experience in SAP implementation and consulting, with at least 5+ years focused on SAP MM module.

·        3+ years in a Solution Architect, Lead Consultant, or Senior Consultant role managing enterprise-level implementations.

·        Proven track record of leading end-to-end SAP MM implementations across multiple industries (automotive, manufacturing, retail, pharma, or FMCG preferred).

·        Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA MM configuration, including Purchase-to-Pay (P2P), Inventory Management, Procurement, and Demand Planning processes.

Technical Knowledge

·        Deep expertise in SAP MM module functionality: Purchasing, Material Planning, Inventory Management, Vendor Management, and Procurement workflows.

·        Strong understanding of SAP module integration: SAP SD (Sales & Distribution), SAP PP (Production Planning), SAP FI/CO (Finance), SAP QM (Quality Management).

·        Experience with SAP Fiori applications, Odata services, and user interface customizations.

·        Knowledge of data migration tools: SAP Data Services, BW/4HANA, or third-party ETL tools.

·        Understanding of ABAP basics (user exits, BADIs, enhancements) and experience collaborating with development teams.

·        Familiarity with SAP S/4HANA architecture, security, and cloud deployment options (SAP Cloud, Private Cloud).

Certifications

·        SAP Certified Application Associate – SAP Materials Management (SAP MM) (highly preferred).

·        SAP Certified Solution Architect – SAP S/4HANA (preferred).

·        Additional SAP certifications in related modules (SD, PP, FI/CO) considered advantageous.

Soft Skills

·        Strategic thinking with ability to align technical solutions to business objectives.

·        Leadership and mentoring capabilities; ability to guide and develop team members.

·        Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to present technical concepts to executive and end-user audiences.

·        Problem-solving and analytical capabilities; strong ability to troubleshoot complex issues and propose innovative solutions.

·        Project management experience; familiarity with Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid methodologies.

·        Change management competency; experience driving organizational change and user adoption initiatives.

Desirable Qualifications

·        Experience with SAP S/4HANA Cloud (Public or Private Edition) implementations.

·        Knowledge of advanced procurement strategies: Vendor-Managed Inventory (VMI), Consignment Inventory, Supplier Collaboration.

·        Exposure to supply chain optimization, demand-driven material requirements planning (DDMRP), or S&OP (Sales & Operations Planning) processes.

·        Experience with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) or Business Intelligence (BI/4HANA) reporting on MM data.

·        Familiarity with Ariba integration for Procure-to-Pay processes.

·        Prior experience in automotive or manufacturing sector implementations.

·        Knowledge of industry-specific SAP solutions or vertical solutions (e.g., SAP for Utilities, SAP for Chemicals).

·        Exposure to robotic process automation (RPA) or intelligent automation in procurement.

About the Role

 

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Senior DevOps Engineer to design, build, and operate a modern cloud-native platform that supports mission-critical applications and data services. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Kubernetes-based infrastructure, GitOps practices, CI/CD automation, database administration, observability, and platform security.

You will play a key role in driving platform reliability, scalability, and developer productivity while mentoring junior engineers and adopting open-source technologies to enhance our engineering ecosystem.

 

Technology Stack (Key Technologies):

Container Orchestration: Kubernetes, Docker

GitOps & CI/CD: ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, Helm

API Gateway & Ingress: Kong Gateway, Traefik

Monitoring & Observability: Grafana, Prometheus, Loki

Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Neo4j, Redis, ClickHouse, Qdrant

Streaming & Messaging: Apache Kafka (Strimzi)

Data Platform: Apache Airflow, Trino, Hive Metastore, OpenMetadata, MinIO (S3)

Security: HashiCorp Vault, OpenBao

 Configuration Management: Ansible

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and manage advanced CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD GitOps).

  • Deploy and operate highly available PostgreSQL & MySQL clusters.
  • Manage Kong API Gateway and optimize Kubernetes infrastructure.
  • Operate and enhance monitoring (Grafana, Prometheus, Loki) and ensure security compliance.
  • Manage Kafka clusters, perform capacity planning, and participate in incident response.
  • Mentor junior engineers and deploy new open-source platforms end-to-end.

  • 8+ years in DevOps, SRE, or Platform Engineering.

  • Expert-level Kubernetes (deployments, StatefulSets, RBAC, CRDs) and Docker.
  • Extensive experience with PostgreSQL/MySQL (HA, replication) and Helm chart development.
  • Proficiency with ArgoCD, Prometheus + Grafana (PromQL), and Apache Kafka.
  • Strong Linux administration, scripting (Bash, Python, Go), and CI/CD (GitHub Actions).
  • Experience with HashiCorp Vault and Traefik ingress controller.

PositionFormattedDescription.Tasks:
WHAT WE DO

Picture the car of the future. Does it fly? Does it look like the one from that famous 80s movie? 

We believe the car of the future is already here—and it’s a connected vehicle that can be used as a payment device. Here at Mercedes pay, we enable seamless, secure, and trustworthy payments across the entire Mercedes-Benz ecosystem. We develop sleek new payment products & solutions to provide customers with an effortless, convenient user experience; not just via an app or web browser, but even in-car. The car as a payment device? We made it happen! 

Mercedes-Benz is known for its legacy, but innovation and legacy are not mutually exclusive—quite the contrary. Our mission is to empower innovation within one of the top luxury car brands worldwide, helping it continue to pioneer the automotive industry. To sum it up, we are the FinTech branch or knowledge hub for payments within Mercedes-Benz.

ABOUT MERCEDES PAY

Mercedes pay launched in its first market in 2018 and is now active in more than 40 countries on five continents, enabling transaction processing for Mercedes-Benz products and services. Depending on the market, Mercedes pay may act as the technical payment gateway for transaction processing from Mercedes me store, the Mercedes me app, in-car payments and may even support online vehicle sales. This is how Mercedes pay directly contributes to the mobility and digitalization strategy of Mercedes-Benz Group AG. Mercedes pay is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz AG with offices in Berlin, Stuttgart, and Farmington Hills (USA).

2023 has already been a big year—we launched full online vehicle payments in the UK and introduced native in-car payments in Germany, an industry-first feature by which users can pay directly by fingerprint inside their car. That’s the car of the future we’re talking about! 

OUR VALUES & HOW WE WORK

We are an inclusive, passionate, and diverse team of people. Being solution-oriented, agile, and dynamic is in our blood. We learn best by leaping into cold water from time to time, by doing rather than deliberating, and we trust in our teammates’ abilities & willingness to learn. We like to make things happen, and we’re more interested in finding solutions than sulking at inconveniences.

Since we are still building new processes alongside new products, new joiners have the opportunity to make as much impact as our most seasoned veterans. We really love a lively exchange of ideas, whether a teammate’s been with us for two days or ten years. And, frankly, fresh energy is always welcome.

YOUR DAY AT GLANCE

  • You assess current systems, infrastructure, and business processes to identify improvement opportunities and ensure compatibility with new solutions

  • You collect and analyze stakeholder requirements to define solution scope and objectives

  • You architect the Mercedes Pay Digital Voucher Solution, detailing structure, components, interfaces, and data flows, and select suitable technologies, platforms, and tools

  • You create proof-of-concept projects to validate solutions and demonstrate feasibility

  • You work with an experienced team of Solution Architects as well as the company's Enterprise, Cloud and Security Architects to derive right-fit solutions

  • You facilitate the collaboration with external development teams, ensuring adherence to architectural guidelines and best practices

  • You communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating complex technical details into accessible language

  • You document solutions and disseminate best practices among team members
PositionFormattedDescription.Qualifications:
WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE

  • You hold a degree in Computer Science or a related field

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a Solution Architect, with a strong focus on software product development

  • You have practical experience in at least one of the following domains: regulatory environments, agentic commerce, loyalty programs, vouchers, digital marketing, or payments (including PCI DSS, PSD2/SCA, or AML/KYC)

  • You are proficient in microservices, event-driven architectures, cloud-native technologies (e.g., Kubernetes, CI/CD), Auth 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC) protocols, alongside practices like Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and DevOps

  • You have hands-on experience with tools such as Jira, GitHub, and Datadog

  • You have a proven track record of implementing cutting-edge technologies within a corporate environment

  • You possess strong teamwork and good communication skills, with the ability to maintain composure under pressure

  • You are fluent in English; German language skills are a strong plus

OUR OFFER TO YOU

·       Modern and dynamic work environment

·       Flexible and mobile working

·       Attractive fitness offer

·       Numerous employee discounts

·       Excellent infrastructure

This is a full-time job (also suitable for part-time). We particularly welcome applications from disabled persons. Please apply online via www.group.mercedes-benz.com/careers (ID:MER0003ZHV). For questions, please don’t hesitate to contact the HR Team of Mercedes pay GmbH: career_mercedespay@mercedes-benz.com

PositionFormattedDescription.Tasks:
Objective of job
  • The function architecture (body) for defining, designing, and evolving the body domain system design next-generation electrical/electronic (E/E) systems. This role shall design the EE control system of body domain in a way that delivers best user experience, safety and security level while balancing the system complexity and cost.
  • You will play a key role in enabling software-defined vehicle capabilities by designing the system in a software/hardware decoupled, highly abstractly way.
Main Tasks:
  • Be the leading role in the organization to identify the development trend of body domain system: new tech, new features, etc.,
  • Be responsible in body domain system design: IO requirements, signal and service requirement, safety and security requirement, diagnostic requirement, function specification, performance requirement.
  • Lead cross-domain architecture reviews and decision-making
  • Collaborate with system architects, software teams, and ECU suppliers to ensure seamless integration
  • Be the 1st responsibility to in performing trouble shooting in the body domain system to ensure the timely and quality delivery.
  • Contribute to long-term E/E architecture roadmap
PositionFormattedDescription.Qualifications:
Qualification

Experience

  • 6+ years of experience in body domain system design, function design
  • Experience with OEM or Tier-1 automotive suppliers is strongly preferred
  • Experience in delivering body domain system design in a centralized EE architecture and SOA platform is preferred

Technical Skills

  • Familiary with Body domain system design. Strong knowledge in designing solution for performance related critical usecase like fast wake up function,  etc., be able to perform critical timing analysis of the system.
  • Familiar with function control logic of body domain, like seat control logic, ambient light control logic, etc.,
